Definition
[Scalar curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0048, petersen:page-0049 ↗ def:pet-ch1-contraction ↗ def:pet-ch1-ricci-types

The scalar curvature is the contraction of the Ricci tensor: \[ \operatorname {scal} =\operatorname {tr}(\operatorname {Ric}) =\operatorname {Ric}^i_i =R^i_{iks}g^{sk} =\operatorname {Ric}_{ik}g^{ki} =R_{ijkl}g^{ik}g^{jl}. \]
